
 Usage: danvas assignments [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Create assignments from Markdown sources or export assignment metadata for
 review.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ export          Export sanitized assignment evidence as JSON, CSV, or        │
│                 Markdown.                                                    │
│ overrides       Export one assignment's override windows and private         │
│                 membership.                                                  │
│ overrides-sync  Plan override reconciliation; use --apply --confirm apply to │
│                 write Canvas.                                                │
│ create          Plan one assignment from Markdown; use --apply to create it  │
│                 in Canvas.                                                   │
│ verify          Verify declared assignment fields and exact current-course   │
│                 Canvas file targets.                                         │
│ update          Plan one assignment update from Markdown; use --apply to     │
│                 write Canvas.                                                │
│ upsert          Plan whether one assignment source would update an existing  │
│                 assignment or create a new one.                              │
│ audit           Compare a saved assignments export to course policy weights  │
│                 and basic setup expectations.                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
